distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；贵州；海南；湖南；江西；四川；西藏；云南；浙江；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Xizang; 黄复生等 (2015) expands the baseline to Hunan, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Guizhou, Fujian, Hainan and Guangxi. Smith et al. (2020) confirms much of this range and adds Guangdong, Hong Kong, Yunnan, Zhejiang and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Baseline host evidence is retained as a union of 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015): Quercus sp., Ficus carica, Machilus sp., Rhus verniciflua, Camellia oleifera and Phoebe sp. Smith et al. (2020) adds no host in the promoted record. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes broad polyphagy and Taiwan records spanning seven genera in four families under Xyleborus amorphus, but because those genera are not enumerated in the curated field, no new host taxa are promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hadrodemius comans (Sampson, 1919).

taxonomic_history.name: Hadrodemius comans
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus amorphus and 黄复生等 (2015) uses Hadrodemius amorphus. Smith et al. (2020) treats the stable taxon as Hadrodemius comans. Beaver & Liu (2010) follows synonymy involving Xyleborus amorphus and X. metacomans; this is retained as nomenclatural provenance without changing the stable VSN. Canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Sampson, 1919), VSN_2867.
